name: crypto-ed25519-sign
algorithm: std Ed25519 (RFC 8032) Sign of n 64-byte messages of splitmix64 bytes under one key whose seed is the first 32 bytes (mk/crypto-ed25519-sign.mk).

skip.c: no std crypto: C has no standard Ed25519
skip.rust: no std crypto: Rust std has no Ed25519; no crate stands in

notes: Work per step: one signature of one 64-byte message (RFC 8032 5.1.6: SHA-512 of prefix and message, one fixed-base multiplication, SHA-512 of R, A and message, a mod-L multiply-add). Mk crypto.Ed25519.Sign and Zig KeyPair.sign (no noise) also hash the seed on every call; Go ed25519.Sign keeps the expanded key (SHA-512 of the seed) in a per-key cache (crypto/ed25519 privateKeyCache), so Go's column does one SHA-512 of 32 bytes less per signature, a single compression. Zig compares the stored public half with the key pair's (32 bytes), not recomputed. Signatures per second = n / median.

Checksums: every column printed the same value at the quick and the publish args in `go run ./tools/bench verify` and `verify -publish-size` (mk built from the tree, Zig 0.17.0, Go 1.27.3) on the owner's machine, 2026-11-07 (std-crypto session 1, with the public half as a third argument; session 2, after D-319, with the key from Ed25519.FromSeed: the same checksums). Not published: no number here is a measurement.
